title: Abandonment of senior citizens - the criminal liability explained
p1:
A parent being left alone by their children is not just a family issue.

In some situations, it can become a criminal matter — and many people do not know this.
p2:
A common misconception is that neglecting elderly parents is only a moral responsibility. The law can also step in when senior citizens are abandoned or left without basic care by those legally responsible for them.

Many are surprised to learn that abandoning a senior citizen can lead to penalties, including legal action against the responsible person.
p3:
The purpose of these laws is not to interfere in family matters, but to protect elderly people who cannot support themselves. If a senior citizen is unable to meet their needs and is deliberately neglected, they may have legal remedies available.

The takeaway: caring for ageing parents is not only about values and relationships — in certain cases, it is also a legal responsibility.
conclusion: Do you think society is doing enough to protect senior citizens from abandonment, or should legal action become stricter? Share your view.
